Backup facility with space and power but no configured equipment
Cheapest option; longest recovery time (days+)
Backup facility with hardware in place but data restored at failover
Middle cost; recovery in hours to a day
Fully equipped duplicate facility with near-live data replication
Most expensive; recovery in minutes
Copy all selected data every run
Simplest restore (one set) but slowest backup and most storage
Copy everything changed since the last full backup
Restore = last full + latest differential; grows until next full
Copy only changes since the last backup of any type
Fastest backups, least storage; restore needs full + every incremental
Point-in-time image of a VM or filesystem
Near-instant capture and rollback; not a substitute for real backups
